nodes.name: personal-ai.architecture.json
nodes.summary: Archify architecture diagram spec for the local-first Personal AI system. Declares components (Users, Open WebUI, FastAPI Gateway, Agent Loop, Ollama, PolicyEngine, Tool Registry, Retrieval, Workspace Sandbox, SQLite Knowledge Base, Job Agent, Job Feeds) whose tags reference real source files (server.py, agent.py, policy.py, tools/, retrieval.py, job_agent/), plus boundaries, 8 labeled connections, and 4 narrative cards covering ingestion, retrieval/memory, execution control plane, and the job agent pipeline.

nodes.name: personal-ai.html
nodes.summary: Standalone explorable HTML viewer generated by archify 2.17.0-dev.1 that renders the Personal AI architecture diagram as inline SVG with dark/light theme presets, embedded JetBrains Mono font subsets (WOFF2), a toolbar, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export support.
nodes.languageNotes: Single generative file bundling inline SVG, toolbar script, theme resolution before first paint, and base64-embedded WOFF2 font data.

nodes.name: personal-ai.visual-check.json
nodes.summary: Automated-browser visual-check report for the architecture HTML artifact. Records the artifact path, sha256 and byte size of personal-ai.html, and reports status 'skipped' with a warning diagnostic because Chrome/Chromium is unavailable, suggesting setting ARCHIFY_CHROME and rerunning the check.
